MISO (Transmission Provider): study cycles, notices, restudies, GIA filing.
Transmission Owner: scoping, facilities, local criteria, construction.

5.5 Transfer of Ownership
The Interconnection Customer may transfer an existing project in the MISO Queue to a new
owner. This can occur when the Interconnection Customer transfers the project to a newly
formed subsidiary LLC (an internal transfer) or when the project entity is sold to another
company (an external transfer).


The Interconnection Customer may also request to change the legal name of their project
with a Name Change request - only applicable when the TAX ID is not changing.
